newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets C&W/BCE joint control of Videotron.
newsitem.headline: EU vets C&W/BCE joint control of Videotron.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was starting a preliminary inquiry into the acquisition by Cable & Wireless Plc and BCE Inc of the joint control of Bell Cablemedia Plc and Videotron Holdings Plc.
It said the deal was notified for clearance under the European Union's merger rules on November 8.

Under the same rules, which ban creation or strengthening of a dominant position in the Union's market, the Commission has about one month from notification to clear the operation or start a full probe.
British companies Bell Cablemedia and Videotron build and operate cable television and telecomunication networks, the Commission said in a statement to be published in the EU's Official Journal.
Bell Cablemedia is currently owned by Bell Canada International, itself a unit of telecommunications firm BCE Inc. Videotron belongs to Videotron Groupe Ltee. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
